name: GOVERN
description: The organization’s cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

categories.name: organizational context
categories.description:
The circumstances — mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements — surrounding the
organization’s cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood

sub_categories.name: GV.OC-01
sub_categories.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

sub_categories.name: GV.OC-02
sub_categories.description: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

sub_categories.name: GV.OC-03
sub_categories.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity — including privacy and civil liberties obligations — are understood and managed

sub_categories.name: GV.OC-04
sub_categories.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

sub_categories.name: GV.OC-05
sub_categories.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

categories.name: Risk Management Strategy
categories.description: The organization’s priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-01
sub_categories.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-02
sub_categories.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-03
sub_categories.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-04
sub_categories.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-05
sub_categories.description: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-06
sub_categories.description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

sub_categories.name: GV.RM-07
sub_categories.description: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

categories.name: Policy
categories.description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated

sub_categories.name: GV.PO-01
sub_categories.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

sub_categories.name: GV.PO-02
sub_categories.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

categories.name: Oversight
categories.description: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy

sub_categories.name: GV.OV-01
sub_categories.description: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

sub_categories.name: GV.OV-02
sub_categories.description: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

sub_categories.name: GV.OV-03
sub_categories.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

categories.name: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
categories.description: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved by organizational stakeholders

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-01
sub_categories.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-02
sub_categories.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-03
sub_categories.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-04
sub_categories.description: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-05
sub_categories.description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-06
sub_categories.description: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-07
sub_categories.description: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-08
sub_categories.description: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-09
sub_categories.description: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

sub_categories.name: GV.SC-10
sub_categories.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

name: IDENTIFY
description: The organization’s current cybersecurity risks are understood

categories.name: Asset Management
categories.description: Assets (e.g., data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people) that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to organizational objectives and the organization’s risk strategy

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-01
sub_categories.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-02
sub_categories.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-03
sub_categories.description: Representations of the organization’s authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-04
sub_categories.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-05
sub_categories.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-07
sub_categories.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

sub_categories.name: ID.AM-08
sub_categories.description: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

categories.name: Risk Assessment
categories.description: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-01
sub_categories.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-02
sub_categories.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-03
sub_categories.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-04
sub_categories.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-05
sub_categories.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-06
sub_categories.description: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-07
sub_categories.description: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-08
sub_categories.description: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-09
sub_categories.description: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

sub_categories.name: ID.RA-10
sub_categories.description: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

name: PROTECT
description: Safeguards to manage the organization’s cybersecurity risks are used

categories.name: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
categories.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access

sub_categories.name: PR.AA-01
sub_categories.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization

sub_categories.name: PR.AA-02
sub_categories.description: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions

sub_categories.name: PR.AA-03
sub_categories.description: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

sub_categories.name: PR.AA-04
sub_categories.description: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

sub_categories.name: PR.AA-05
sub_categories.description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties

sub_categories.name: PR.AA-06
sub_categories.description: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk

categories.name: Awareness and Training
categories.description: The organization’s personnel are provided with cybersecurity awareness and training so that they can perform their cybersecurity-related tasks

sub_categories.name: PR.AT-01
sub_categories.description: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

sub_categories.name: PR.AT-02
sub_categories.description: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

categories.name: Data Security
categories.description: Data are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information

sub_categories.name: PR.DS-01
sub_categories.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

sub_categories.name: PR.DS-10
sub_categories.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

sub_categories.name: PR.DS-11
sub_categories.description: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

categories.name: Platform Security
categories.description: The hardware, software (e.g., firmware, operating systems, applications), and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization’s risk strategy to protect their confidentiality, integrity, and availability

sub_categories.name: PR.PS-01
sub_categories.description: Configuration management practices are established and applied

sub_categories.name: PR.PS-02
sub_categories.description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

sub_categories.name: PR.PS-03
sub_categories.description: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

sub_categories.name: PR.PS-04
sub_categories.description: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

sub_categories.name: PR.PS-05
sub_categories.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

sub_categories.name: PR.PS-06
sub_categories.description: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle

categories.name: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
categories.description: Security architectures are managed with the organization’s risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and organizational resilience

sub_categories.name: PR.IR-01
sub_categories.description: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

sub_categories.name: PR.IR-02
sub_categories.description: The organization’s technology assets are protected from environmental threats

sub_categories.name: PR.IR-03
sub_categories.description: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

sub_categories.name: PR.IR-04
sub_categories.description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

name: DETECT
description: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed

categories.name: Continuous Monitoring
categories.description: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events

sub_categories.name: DE.CM-01
sub_categories.description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

sub_categories.name: DE.CM-02
sub_categories.description: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events

sub_categories.name: DE.CM-03
sub_categories.description: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events

sub_categories.name: DE.CM-06
sub_categories.description: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

sub_categories.name: DE.CM-09
sub_categories.description: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

categories.name: Adverse Event Analysis
categories.description: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize the events and detect cybersecurity incidents

sub_categories.name: DE.AE-02
sub_categories.description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

sub_categories.name: DE.AE-03
sub_categories.description: Information is correlated from multiple sources

sub_categories.name: DE.AE-04
sub_categories.description: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood

sub_categories.name: DE.AE-06
sub_categories.description: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools

sub_categories.name: DE.AE-07
sub_categories.description: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

sub_categories.name: DE.AE-08
sub_categories.description: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria

name: RESPOND
description: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken

categories.name: Incident Management
categories.description: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed

sub_categories.name: RS.MA-01
sub_categories.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared

sub_categories.name: RS.MA-02
sub_categories.description: Incident reports are triaged and validated

sub_categories.name: RS.MA-03
sub_categories.description: Incidents are categorized and prioritized

sub_categories.name: RS.MA-04
sub_categories.description: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

sub_categories.name: RS.MA-05
sub_categories.description: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

categories.name: Incident Analysis
categories.description: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities

sub_categories.name: RS.AN-03
sub_categories.description: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident

sub_categories.name: RS.AN-06
sub_categories.description: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records’ integrity and provenance are preserved

sub_categories.name: RS.AN-07
sub_categories.description: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved

sub_categories.name: RS.AN-08
sub_categories.description: An incident’s magnitude is estimated and validated

categories.name: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
categories.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies

sub_categories.name: RS.CO-02
sub_categories.description: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

sub_categories.name: RS.CO-03
sub_categories.description: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders

categories.name: Incident Mitigation
categories.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects

sub_categories.name: RS.MI-01
sub_categories.description: Incidents are contained

sub_categories.name: RS.MI-02
sub_categories.description: Incidents are eradicated

name: RECOVER
description: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored

categories.name: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
categories.description: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents

sub_categories.name: RC.RP-01
sub_categories.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process

sub_categories.name: RC.RP-02
sub_categories.description: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed

sub_categories.name: RC.RP-03
sub_categories.description: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration

sub_categories.name: RC.RP-04
sub_categories.description: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms

sub_categories.name: RC.RP-05
sub_categories.description: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed

sub_categories.name: RC.RP-06
sub_categories.description: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed

categories.name: Incident Recovery Communication
categories.description: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties

sub_categories.name: RC.CO-03
sub_categories.description: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders

sub_categories.name: RC.CO-04
sub_categories.description: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging
